name: Runtime
description: Core runtime capabilities available to every agent.
examples: Upload the exported screenshots to the shared folder
Store this generated file where the team can access it
Open the app in a browser and capture a screenshot
Click through this page and verify the form works
long_description: Runtime provides core Hivy-managed capabilities that every agent receives automatically. Drive lets agents save generated files, screenshots, reports, and other artifacts to a shared destination that your team can revisit later. Browser lets agents use Agent Browser from inside the sandbox to inspect, interact with, and capture web applications.
